name: Colombo
tagline: Tropical Island Capital with Unbeatable Value
description: Colombo is Sri Lanka's vibrant capital, offering a blend of colonial architecture, Buddhist temples, and modern development along the Indian Ocean coast. The cost of living is remarkably low, and the city serves as a gateway to Sri Lanka's stunning beaches, hill country, and wildlife. A growing expat community and improving infrastructure make it an increasingly attractive FIRE destination.

quickFacts.visa: 30-day ETA visa on arrival, extendable to 6 months. My Dream Home visa for retirees (55+) with $15K deposit. Long-term tourist visa renewals are straightforward.
quickFacts.safetyRating: Moderate – generally safe; be aware of petty crime in tourist areas

housing.description: Modest semi-furnished 1BR or self-contained annex in a suburb (Dehiwala / Nugegoda / Wellawatte edge)

dining.description: Mostly home cooking; a few local rice-and-curry "hotels" / casual meals out

healthcare.description: Inexpensive local private cover for hospital stays, priced for an early retiree aged 45-55.

1M.lifestyle: A modest self-contained apartment or annex in a quiet suburb like Dehiwala or the Wellawatte edge, with home cooking supplemented by rice-and-curry "hotels" and street kottu. Getting around on buses and the occasional PickMe tuk-tuk. Basic local private health cover handles routine care at the major private hospitals. Walks along Galle Face and beach afternoons at Mount Lavinia cost almost nothing. Comfortable and genuinely affordable, though imported goods and Western-style dining stay outside this budget.

housing.description: Spacious 3BR apartment in Colombo 3 (Kollupitiya) or modern condo in Colombo 7

dining.description: Mix of upscale restaurants at Colombo Fort, boutique cafes, and local favorites

healthcare.description: Premium private insurance covering top Colombo hospitals and specialist care

transportation.description: Own small car or regular ride-hailing; weekend trips to Kandy and Galle

entertainment.description: Gym membership, diving trips to Hikkaduwa, cultural events, weekend getaways to hill country

2M.lifestyle: A nicer furnished apartment in a good suburb, with dining out a couple of times a week across a mix of local and mid-range spots. A blend of cabs, tuk-tuks, and buses covers daily movement, and a mid-tier local health plan handles routine and hospital care. Cinema, a light gym habit, and social outings fit easily, with a comfortable cushion left over at Colombo's prices.

housing.description: Furnished, A/C 1BR in a good central area (Colombo 4/5/6 — Wellawatte / Bambalapitiya, or edge of Colombo 3)

dining.description: Regular dining out including mid-range and Western spots

healthcare.description: Comprehensive local individual plan, higher sum insured + riders

entertainment.description: Gym membership, cinema, social dining, occasional weekend trip

3M.lifestyle: A furnished, air-conditioned apartment in a central district like Bambalapitiya or Wellawatte (Colombo 4–6), with dining out several times a week across local favorites and the growing mid-range and Western scene. Ride-hailing and tuk-tuks replace the need to own a car. Comprehensive local health insurance with a higher sum insured covers the major private hospitals. A gym membership, an active social calendar, and easy weekend escapes to the south coast or hill country all fit comfortably, leaving real monthly margin at Colombo's cost of living.

housing.description: Luxury villa in Colombo 7 or oceanfront property in the southern coast suburbs

dining.description: Private chef plus regular fine dining at Colombo's top restaurants and hotels

healthcare.description: VIP concierge medical with access to Singapore hospitals for major procedures

transportation.description: Luxury vehicle with driver, domestic flights, seaplane transfers

entertainment.description: Private whale watching, luxury safari lodges, yacht charters, international travel

domesticHelp.description: Full-time cook, housekeeper, gardener, and driver

luxuryExtras.description: International first-class travel, luxury hotel stays, philanthropy, art collecting

5M.lifestyle: A high-end furnished apartment or premium condo in Colombo 3 or Colombo 7, with part-time household help a few days a week and heavy use of ride-hailing plus the occasional hired driver. Frequent upscale dining, cafes, and hotel restaurants, and a premium grocery basket leaning on imports. Upper-tier health cover bridges toward international plans. Club memberships and regular leisure travel are easily absorbed, and the low local cost base leaves a wide margin each month.

housing.description: Luxury condo or house in Colombo 7 (Cinnamon Gardens) or Colombo 3 — Cinnamon Life / Altair / Havelock City tier

dining.description: Fine dining and five-star hotel restaurants, frequent

healthcare.description: International / evacuation-grade cover with Singapore/Bangkok hospital access

10M.lifestyle: A branded luxury condominium or house in Cinnamon Gardens (Colombo 7) or Colombo 3 — the Havelock City, Altair, or Cinnamon Life tier — with a private car and full-time driver, and live-in help running the home and kitchen. Fine dining at the city's best restaurants and five-star hotels is routine, groceries lean on premium imports, and international health cover provides direct access to Singapore and Bangkok hospitals for anything serious. Club memberships, golf, and frequent international travel round out the discretionary budget. This far exceeds what Colombo's cost of living can absorb, so this level typically uses Sri Lanka as an affordable tropical base and travels extensively.
